examinations.name: Installed-package independence
examinations.scope: Installed wheel CLI smoke; full wheel/sdist base/pixel acceptance lives in the package workflow.

examinations.name: Biological-metadata blindness
examinations.scope: External label changes leave handcrafted features and distances unchanged.

examinations.name: Filename independence
examinations.scope: Renamed files with identical decoded pixels produce identical features and distances.

examinations.name: Controlled pixel sensitivity
examinations.scope: Synthetic size/intensity changes have expected measurement effects.

examinations.name: Statistical stability and uncertainty
examinations.scope: Paired fixed-prediction query/cluster bootstrap contracts; split/training variation still requires a separate repeated-fit design.
